posts.text: The thread has been inactive for a year, reflecting the stock’s sobering mood. The Stock has been in a Time correction for 3 years since the Attraco acquisition. While the company has been digesting its acquisition-led expansion spree, the external macro environment has been hit by back-to-back challenges. I’ve been caught on the optimistic side in this counter. I’ve used AI to create scenarios to derive fair value and try to reduce bias.
